title: Case Study: Raiffeisenbank Regio Frick-Mettauertal Improves Security and Efficiency
summary: Learn how Raiffeisenbank replaced Opteva devices with DN Series® systems, which enhanced security features with ease of use and industry-leading energy efficiency.
body_markdown:
The DN Series system family offers greater security by design. The intelligent banknote pathway within the ATMs makes it virtually impossible for criminals to gain access to the safe. The most comprehensive base layer of security in the industry can be complemented with advanced protection measures to deter and thwart attacks. Raiffeisenbank Regio Frick-Mettauertal equipped its entire fleet with intelligent inking systems and enabled NFC technology for cardless withdrawals and contactless transactions, further enhancing security and convenience for customers.


[Download the case study to read the full story.](https://www.dieboldnixdorf.com/-/media/diebold/files/banking/insights/case-study/dn_case-study_raiffeisenbank.pdf)
